blueprint: Value Proposition of the AWS Cloud
question: Which statement BEST describes the value proposition of the AWS Cloud?
choices: Organizations can access technology resources on demand without owning every underlying component
Organizations must purchase enough physical hardware for their highest possible demand
Organizations must manage every AWS data center that hosts their workloads
Organizations can use AWS only for short-term development projects
explanation: The AWS Cloud provides technology resources on demand while AWS operates the underlying cloud infrastructure, allowing customers to focus more on their workloads and business needs.

blueprint: Global Infrastructure Benefits > Speed of Deployment
question: Which AWS Cloud benefit allows a team to provision computing resources in minutes instead of waiting for physical servers to arrive?
explanation: On-demand provisioning improves the speed of deployment because cloud resources can be created quickly without a traditional hardware purchasing and installation cycle.

question: Which AWS Cloud benefit helps an organization deploy an application closer to customers in different parts of the world?
explanation: AWS global reach enables organizations to deploy workloads in geographic locations closer to users, which can support international expansion and reduce latency.

question: What does high availability mean for a cloud workload?
choices: The workload remains accessible despite certain component failures
The workload always runs on the largest available server
The workload can be used only during scheduled business hours
The workload stores all data on one physical device
explanation: High availability is the ability of a workload to remain accessible and operational when individual components or locations experience failures.

question: Which cloud characteristic adds or removes resources as workload demand changes?
explanation: Elasticity allows resources to expand when demand increases and contract when demand decreases so capacity can follow the workload.

question: Which AWS Cloud benefit enables teams to experiment and respond to changing business needs quickly?
explanation: Cloud agility lets teams provision, test, change, and retire resources quickly, helping the organization respond faster to new requirements and opportunities.
